posts.title: good mental health
posts.description: I sometimes wish that I could just have good mental health and let it stay that way for the rest of my life. I don't want to have to wake up every morning and meditate, journal, and do boring-ass stuff to keep my mind healthy. I just want a healthy mind. But that's just the way it is. posts.title: should I listen or give advice?
posts.description: I had a talk with a friend recently, and he kept asking me about what to do about this girl he was seeing. I listened to him and asked him questions, but I didn't give him any advice on what to do. About 10 minutes in, he started to get a bit irritated with me.
